hold_text: PHONE-SELF-DIAGNOSE. Touches the prop phone executor (Kotlin: FLAG_SECURE scope + per-image blank measure; needs ONE APK install) and the web API (new read-only GET /api/bot/prop/phone_steps; capture meta gains device_img_std / img_why / image_check). No order-path decision reads any new field. Manager merges and deploys (ict-web-api restart via the deploy path); the APK is the operator's one install. Revert: git revert.
why: Close the phone executor's diagnosis loop: the operator can screenshot every non-credential screen, every step capture says whether its image is real or blank, and a lane reads the steps on the bot tier without the diag token.
